speaker: josias_thwaite
text: Evening prayer. I am not turning the glass. The morning had the sermon.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then let it be a prayer and not a second morning. I have a house to shut.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Amen to a short one. I am not asking for fourteenthly at this hour.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: You shall not have it. Amen.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Amen. The close is dressed, and I am going back to my own door.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: And I to mine. The lamp can burn itself out. I am not standing under it again today.
